cases.mechanism: ThinkParser.parse does `text.split("</think>")[-1]`, keeping only the text after the LAST </think>. Here that is the stray </think> placed inside the box, leaving 'NEUTRAL}'. That fragment has no \boxed{, so extract_boxed_answer (non-strict) passes it through unchanged. In correct_label_reward_func, 'NEUTRAL}' is not exact, but `"NEUTRAL" in parsed` maps it to NEUTRAL, which equals the gold answer.
cases.why_incorrect: The answer the response actually boxes begins with CONTRADICTION, and the final segment contains no complete \boxed{} at all. The verifier finds no box after the last </think>, so it marks the response unanswered/wrong.
